description_en: Unique villa in one of the most sought-after areas of Tirana - near Dry Lake. Positioned in an elite residence, this villa has been conceived to offer a lifestyle that combines modern aesthetics with the natural feel of rustic materials. An architectural project thought out in detail, offering privacy, space and tranquility in the heart of greenery.
